brief: Crews must apply the loading reductions required by MG-021 if the heat event extends beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, noting that Kingsley Green 138/13kV has an ONAN cooling type. The supplied documents do not specify any other procedural steps for this asset under the current event conditions. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period in accordance with MG-021.
